name: High Priest Thekal
notes: Numbers follow docs/research/zul-gurub/thekal.md: Thekal 133,250 (+ Lor'Khan 90,650 + Zath 113,295), tiger form resets him to full. Modelled phases: the council (100-20%), the 10 s kill window (10 s per cmangos, the wiki and Wowhead; DBM shows a 15 s bar, so the length is not settled; three bodies must drop inside it or they rise, shown as a short phase where the two Zealots are killFirst at their low health and his clock ends), tiger form from full health (100-20%, threat reset, permanent haste as the engine's `enrage`), and the last 20% Enrage as a separate non-dispellable tank debuff because the engine has one enrage flag. Cadences for Great Heal, Silence, Mortal Cleave, Force Punch, Speed Slash and Charge are estimates that could not be verified (no boss mod times Force Punch and Warcraft Logs was not reachable); the research has no timer for any of them except Guardians (every minute). Boss melee (280 per 2 s) is scaled so a 10,000 HP tank survives normal play and dies if the healer ignores a spike. The 10 s window cannot fail in this engine: Thekal's HP is a fixed clock and it ends the phase on time regardless. The window is scored instead by attacks off priority (Zealots first) and by the player's own kill speed on them; a wipe from one Zealot rising alone is not reproducible. Lor'Khan and Zath are present through the council phase as killable (not priority) adds that lose health to the raid over the phase length; Great Heal on any of them is one `offBoss` interruptible cast, with no target selection. Gouge, Blind, Kick, Lightning Shield, Bloodlust and Dispel Magic are left out because the Zealots are `adds` without abilities; Zath's tank swaps cannot be expressed. Silence (Thekal) is a Magic debuff on a random player and the only dispel in the council phase. Mortal Cleave is a 5 s -50% healing received debuff on the tank (via `healingMult`), scored by the healer through tank health. Force Punch is a 1 s cast `knockback` with `radial: true` reaching 45 yd and a separate follow-up `targetSwitch`, because in the real fight the punch drops him off the main tank and a second tank must Taunt. The engine's own threat cut was not used because it would hand the player aggro the instant a DPS is near the top of the table. The knockback strength is 8 yd, shorter than live, because the tank stands near the alcove wall which stops a push and the scoring needs a fair recovery window (a longer shove is still shortened by the wall). Charge is a `targetSwitch` teleport to the raid's edge, with the Taunt timer spaced so Force Punch and Charge never overlap the 10 s Taunt cooldown (real raids have a second tank for that). Zulian Guardians are killFirst adds held by the off-tank role; the real CC is not modelled. The two pull Tigers are killFirst adds.

tank.label: Main tank
tank.description: Hold Thekal south of his hut through the council, take him back when he rises as a tiger, and Taunt after every Force Punch. Back against the alcove wall so the knockback is short.

offtank.label: Zealot off-tank
offtank.description: Your job is Zealot Zath in the council and Zulian Guardians in tiger form. Lor'Khan goes to another off-tank. Pick them up, hold them on your spot and keep them off the raid.

melee.label: Melee DPS
melee.description: Tigers first, then split as the raid leader calls: Thekal to 20%, Zath to 15%, Lor'Khan to 10%, then all three together inside 10 s. Interrupt Great Heal. In tiger form stay on him and be ready to run back in after each Force Punch.

ranged.label: Ranged DPS
ranged.description: Stand in the middle of the triangle, kill the Tigers, interrupt Great Heal and watch the health bars. In tiger form put your back to a wall and stop after each Force Punch until the tank has him.

healer.label: Healer
healer.description: Dispel Silence the moment it lands, heal through Mortal Cleave windows (healing received is halved), and in tiger form stand with your back to a wall: Force Punch hits everyone for 875 and shoves you.

taunt.label: Taunt
taunt.tip: Taunt forces the boss onto you for a few seconds and puts you on top of the threat table. Press it the moment the boss turns on the raid, never while it is already on you.

attack.label: Attack
attack.tip: Attacks generate threat. Stop when the threat bar turns red so the boss stays on the tank.

heal.label: Heal the tank
heal.tip: A large heal for the tank. Time it to land with the incoming damage.

dispel.label: Dispel
dispel.tip: Dispel Silence the instant it lands, healers and interrupters first.

interrupt.label: Interrupt
interrupt.tip: Lor'Khan's Great Heal is a 4 s cast that heals any of the three for 37,000. Interrupt it, every time. Kick, Pummel, Earth Shock, Counterspell.

pullTigers.label: Zulian Tigers
pullTigers.tip: Two Tigers charge in on the pull. Kill them first.

zealotLorKhan.label: Zealot Lor'Khan
zealotLorKhan.tip: Lor'Khan is tanked at the far corner: she casts Great Heal on whoever is lowest.

zealotZath.label: Zealot Zath
zealotZath.tip: Zath is tanked at the opposite corner: he Gouges and Blinds his tank, so his tank needs a Taunt partner.

greatHeal.label: Great Heal
greatHeal.tip: Lor'Khan casts Great Heal for 37,000 on whoever is lowest. Interrupt it every time.

silence.label: Silence
silence.tip: Silences a random player for 6 s. Dispel it, especially on a healer or an interrupter.

mortalCleave.label: Mortal Cleave
mortalCleave.tip: His main tank takes a big hit and has healing cut in half for 5 s. Keep the tank high going into it.

zealotFinishL.label: Lor'Khan: finish her
zealotFinishL.tip: Ten seconds to kill all three. Everybody on the Zealots first.

zealotFinishZ.label: Zath: finish him
zealotFinishZ.tip: Ten seconds to kill all three. Everybody on the Zealots first.

tigerWipe.label: Tiger form: threat reset
tigerWipe.toast: Thekal rises as a tiger: threat wiped
tigerWipe.tip: Five seconds after the three fall he rises as a tiger at full health. The table is empty; the tank Taunts before the DPS start.

aspectOfShirvallah.label: Aspect of Shirvallah
aspectOfShirvallah.tip: He swings much faster in tiger form.

forcePunch.label: Force Punch
forcePunch.tip: A 1 s cast: 875 and a shove for everyone within 45 yd, and he drops the tank. Back against a wall, and the next tank Taunts.

punchSwitch.label: Force Punch drops the tank
punchSwitch.toast: Force Punch drops him off the tank
punchSwitch.tip: After the punch he turns on the next target. Taunt him back.

speedSlash.label: Speed Slash
speedSlash.tip: A melee-range slash for 438 and a 6 s bleed: 438 a second at full value.

charge.label: Charge
charge.tip: He charges a random player and comes back to the tank when taunted.

guardians.label: Zulian Guardians
guardians.tip: He summons two Guardians on transform and every minute after. Off-tank takes them, DPS kill one at a time.

enrage20.label: Enrage
enrage20.tip: At 20% he enrages: +60% attack speed and more damage on every hit. Healers pour it on.

phases.name: The council
phases.subtitle: Tigers, Great Heal, keep the three in step

expectations.label: Hold Thekal south of his hut
expectations.tip: Taunt him and hold him here, away from the Zealots: Lor'Khan must not be able to reach him.

expectations.label: Pick up Zealot Zath
expectations.tip: Zath goes to your corner. Grab him before he reaches anyone.

expectations.label: Keep Zath off the raid
expectations.tip: Hold him at your corner. A loose Zath means Blinds and Gouges on healers.

expectations.label: Kill the Tigers first, then split as called
expectations.tip: Two Tigers die first. Then the raid leader calls who to hit: Thekal 20%, Zath 15%, Lor'Khan 10%.

expectations.label: Interrupt every Great Heal
expectations.tip: Each one puts 37,000 back on one of the three. Have your interrupt ready.

expectations.label: Never pull aggro off the tank
expectations.tip: Stop attacking while the threat bar is red. Resume when it leaves the red band.

expectations.label: Dispel Silence
expectations.tip: Silence on a healer or an interrupter is the danger. Dispel it the moment it lands.

expectations.label: Keep the tank alive
expectations.tip: Thekal hits hard and Mortal Cleave halves your heals. Keep the tank high going into each one.

expectations.label: Keep the tank above half
expectations.tip: Do not let the tank sit under half: healing is halved for 5 s after Mortal Cleave.

expectations.label: Keep Zath in place for the kill
expectations.tip: Do not let him walk. The raid needs him where they are facing.

expectations.label: Zealots first in the kill window
expectations.tip: Hit the Zealots first; Thekal is on the last ten percent. All three down inside 10 s or they get back up.

expectations.label: Keep the tank alive
expectations.tip: Keep the tank alive for the rise.

phases.name: Tiger form
phases.subtitle: Full health, threat reset, Force Punch

expectations.label: Taunt him as he rises
expectations.tip: He comes back at full health with an empty threat table. Taunt inside 3 s.

expectations.label: Drag him to the alcove wall
expectations.tip: Force Punch shoves everyone: your back to the wall means you only go a few yards.

expectations.label: Taunt after every Force Punch
expectations.tip: The punch drops him off you. Taunt within 3 s and walk him back to the wall.

expectations.label: Taunt him back after a Charge
expectations.tip: Same as the punch: he went for someone else. Taunt.

expectations.label: Grab the Guardians
expectations.tip: Run to them and Taunt. Do not let them reach the healers.

expectations.label: Guardians first
expectations.tip: Kill them one at a time. Polymorph the other if you can.

expectations.label: Never pull aggro off the tank
expectations.tip: Stop attacking while the threat bar is red. Resume when it leaves the red band.

expectations.label: Stop until the tank has him back
expectations.tip: After a Force Punch the tank is at zero with him. Do not be the one he turns on.

expectations.label: Keep the tank alive
expectations.tip: He hits twice as fast as a tiger. Keep heals landing on the tank every time he comes back.

expectations.label: Keep the tank above half
expectations.tip: Force Punch drops the tank too. Top them before it lands.

expectations.label: Taunt after every Force Punch
expectations.tip: Keep going until he falls.

expectations.label: Never pull aggro off the tank
expectations.tip: Stop attacking while the threat bar is red. Resume when it leaves the red band.

expectations.label: Keep the tank alive
expectations.tip: Enrage at 20%: the biggest heals you have now.

expectations.label: Keep the tank above half
expectations.tip: One bad second at 20% and the tank is gone.

threatLostCount.label: Times the boss turned on the raid

aggroPulls.label: Times you pulled aggro
aggroPulls.tip: Stop attacking when the threat bar turns red.

attacksInRed.label: Attacks in the red band
attacksInRed.tip: Stop attacking in the red band so the tank can regain a threat lead.

earlyAttacks.label: Attacks before the tank had the boss
earlyAttacks.tip: Give the tank a few seconds after the pull.

dpsIdle.label: Seconds not attacking when you could
dpsIdle.tip: Keep attacking when it's safe. Stop if the threat bar turns red or the boss leaves the tank.

playerInHazard.label: Seconds standing in something bad
playerInHazard.tip: Move out of the ground effect before attacking again.

tankLowSeconds.label: Seconds with the tank under half
tankLowSeconds.tip: Top the tank up before the spike lands, not after.

overheals.label: Wasted heals
overheals.tip: Avoid healing the tank at full health. Save the heal for incoming damage.

debuffSeconds.label: Seconds with a dispellable debuff up

attacksOffPriority.label: Boss attacks while a priority add was alive
attacksOffPriority.tip: Face the add and kill it first. The boss can wait.

whelpsOnRaid.label: Adds loose on the raid
whelpsOnRaid.tip: Grab the adds before they reach a raid member and keep them on you.

cues.notes: Taunt on the rise and every Force Punch, the off-tank grabs Zath and the Guardians, Interrupt Great Heal, Dispel Silence, Heal.

list.label: Taunt when Thekal turns on the raid
list.tip: Taunt as soon as the boss turns toward the raid.

list.label: Heal the tank when they drop low
list.tip: The tank is below half health and a big hit is coming. Heal now.

list.label: Grab Zath
list.tip: Taunt him before he reaches anyone.

list.label: Interrupt Great Heal
list.tip: Lor'Khan has started a 4 s Great Heal. Interrupt inside the cast.

list.label: Dispel it
list.tip: Dispel the moment it lands. Tank first, then healers, then everyone else.

drills.name: Force Punch recovery
drills.description: In tiger form. He punches and you Taunt him back, again and again.

drills.name: Zath and the Guardians
drills.description: Pick up Zath, then the Guardians, and keep them off the raid.

drills.name: Great Heal interrupts
drills.description: Interrupt every Great Heal while holding your threat. Lor'Khan casts it from anywhere.

drills.name: Silence and Mortal Cleave
drills.description: Dispel every Silence and keep the tank alive through Mortal Cleave windows.

limitations: The three enemies do not have separate health bars or resurrection rules. A timed window replaces synchronising their deaths.
